# T3 True-cost analysis — Austin (ZIP3 787)
Method: true-cost skill. Terms re-checked with get_offer (mobile lines=3) on 2026-11-05. Autopay/paperless accepted. All internet taxes $0.

## Internet — eligible, ranked by 24-mo cost
| # | offer_id | monthly math | one-time | 12-mo | 24-mo |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | int-metronet-500 | 49.99 x 12 = 599.88; 49.99 x 24 | 0 | 599.88 | **1,199.76** |
| 2 | int-lonestar-fiber-1g | 60 x 12 + 49 ; 60 x 24 + 49 | 49 activation | 769.00 | 1,489.00 |
| 3 | int-hillcountry-cable-500 (Sponsored) | (30+14) x 12 = 528; + (80+14) x 12 = 1,128 | 0 | 528.00 | 1,656.00 |

Ineligible:
- int-skylink-home-5g (Sponsored): typical download 415 < 500 (the 1000 is an "up to" max). Would be $50 x 24 = 1,200.00.
- Not available in 787: int-bayline-connect-600 (also cap 1229 GB < 1452 peak), int-bayline-gig-loyalty, int-bayline-perf-500 (also 10 up < 20), int-fiberly-1g, int-fiberly-500, int-sonic-wave-1g (also 12-mo contract).
- Install by 2026-12-07: lead time not in catalog for any offer — must be confirmed with provider.

## Mobile (3 lines) — eligible, ranked by 24-mo cost
| # | offer_id | monthly math | roaming / one-time | 12-mo | 24-mo |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | mob-orbit-essentials | (75 + 9 tax) = 84 x 12 = 1,008; x 24 = 2,016 | MX day pass $10 x 10 days/yr: 100 (12 mo), 200 (24 mo) | 1,108.00 | **2,216.00** |
| 2 | mob-northstar-max | (120 − 15 autopay + 0 tax) = 105 x 12; x 24 | MX included | 1,260.00 | 2,520.00 |

Ineligible:
- mob-carrierco-welcome (Sponsored): hotspot 5 GB < 16.4 (line A). Would be (90+15) x 12 + (135+15) x 12 = 3,060.00 /24 mo (1,260.00 /12 mo).
- mob-pebble-unlimited: hotspot 10 GB < 16.4.
- mob-tandem-flex-60: 60 GB pool, hotspot uses plan data; peak combined Jul-26 = 41.0+10.2+3.4+16.4 = 71.0 GB > 60.
- mob-volt-15 (Sponsored): 15 GB data/line < 41.0 (line A); hotspot 15 < 16.4.
- Carrierco Unlimited Plus (current plan) not in the 787 catalog; only Carrierco Unlimited Welcome (ineligible, above).

## Baseline "today" (24 mo)
- Internet Bayline: 109.49 x 24 = 2,627.76
- Mobile Carrierco: 183.40 x 24 = 4,401.60
- Total baseline_24mo = 7,029.36

## Choice
- internet_offer_id = int-metronet-500 → internet_24mo = 1,199.76 (12-mo 599.88)
- mobile_offer_id = mob-orbit-essentials → mobile_24mo = 2,216.00 (12-mo 1,108.00; includes $200 MX day passes for line B)
- savings_24mo = 7,029.36 − (1,199.76 + 2,216.00) = **3,613.60**
- Install lead time for int-metronet-500: not given in catalog — confirm with MetroNet that it can be live by Mon 2026-12-07. Equipment: none listed ($0 equipment, no fees) — confirm whether an ONT/router is provided at install.
- Orbit: no activation fee; buy MX day passes ($10/day) for line B before each trip.

# Move plan for Priya: San Jose → Austin (787), move day Sat 2026-12-05

**Bottom line:** switch to MetroNet Fiber 500 for internet and Orbit Essentials for the 3 phones. Over 24 months that costs **$3,415.76** instead of **$7,029.36**, which saves **$3,613.60** ($1,806.80 in the first year).

## Internet: MetroNet Fiber 500 (int-metronet-500)
- $49.99/mo flat: 500 down / 500 up (typical), no data cap, no contract, no equipment or fees listed, $0 one-time. Sold in 787.
- Cost: 12 months **$599.88** · 24 months **$1,199.76** (49.99 × 24).
- Runner-up: int-lonestar-fiber-1g at $1,489.00 over 24 months ($60/mo + $49 activation).
- Not chosen: int-hillcountry-cable-500 (Sponsored) qualifies but costs $1,656.00 because the $30 promo rises to $80 after 12 months, plus a $14/mo modem. int-skylink-home-5g (Sponsored) is too slow (typical download 415 Mbps, below the 500 you need). Bayline, Fiberly and Sonic plans aren't sold in 787.
- **Check when ordering:** the catalog doesn't give an install lead time. Confirm it can be live by **Mon 2026-12-07**, and ask whether a router/ONT comes with it.

## Phones: Orbit Essentials, 3 lines (mob-orbit-essentials)
- $75/mo + $9 taxes = $84/mo. Unlimited data, 20 GB hotspot per line (covers line A's 16.4 GB peak), you keep all 3 numbers, no activation fee.
- Mexico isn't included. Line B buys a $10/day pass, about 10 days a year, which adds $200 over 24 months.
- Cost: 12 months **$1,108.00** · 24 months **$2,216.00** (84 × 24 + 200).
- Runner-up: mob-northstar-max at $2,520.00 over 24 months ($105/mo with autopay, Mexico included).
- Not chosen: mob-carrierco-welcome (Sponsored) has too little hotspot (5 GB) and would cost $3,060.00. mob-pebble-unlimited's 10 GB hotspot is too small. mob-tandem-flex-60's 60 GB shared pool is less than your 71.0 GB peak. mob-volt-15 (Sponsored) gives only 15 GB data and 15 GB hotspot. Your current Carrierco Unlimited Plus isn't sold in 787.

## 24-month cost vs. today
| | Today (24 mo) | New (24 mo) | Savings |
|---|---|---|---|
| Internet | $2,627.76 (Bayline $109.49 × 24) | $1,199.76 | $1,428.00 |
| Phones | $4,401.60 (Carrierco $183.40 × 24) | $2,216.00 | $2,185.60 |
| **Total** | **$7,029.36** | **$3,415.76** | **$3,613.60** |

## To-do list (also in outbox/move-week.ics)
- **Mon 2026-11-09:** Order MetroNet (int-metronet-500). Book the install for Fri 12-04 (Sat 12-05 at the latest), and confirm the lead time and router/ONT.
- **Mon 2026-11-09:** Start moving all 3 lines to Orbit (mob-orbit-essentials) and keep your numbers. Don't cancel Carrierco yourself until the transfer is done, because finishing the transfer closes the old lines.
- **Mon 2026-11-09:** Review and send the Bayline cancellation letter (outbox/bayline-cancellation.md), effective 12-05.
- **Thu 2026-12-03, before 6 pm:** Return the Bayline XB-8 modem at the San Jose store and keep the receipt.
- **Fri 2026-12-04:** Pick up the keys in Austin. MetroNet install (someone has to be home).
- **Sat 2026-12-05:** Moving day. Bayline cancellation takes effect.
- **Mon 2026-12-07, 8:00 CT:** Check the internet works and run a speed test before work. Phone hotspot is the backup.
- **Before each Mexico trip:** Buy Orbit day passes for line B ($10/day).
